title: PowerPoint on Mac: reference an attached deck's style when editing with Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's release notes support the attached-deck styling workflow, and the licence assignment path and PowerShell call match the documentation. The Microsoft 365 Copilot licence requirement is correctly stated, and the briefing distinguishes roadmap scope from the broader release-notes entry.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Per-user licence assignments are available in Microsoft 365 admin center at Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph PowerShell assigns a licence using Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @().
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences needs at least the License Administrator or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.
